mPDF Data (Local Note)
======================
Data assets used by mPDF for rendering.

Contents
--------
- CSS: mpdf.css, lang2fonts.css
- Mappings: entity_substitutions.php, upperCase.php
- Collations: collations/
- Fonts: font/
- Color Profiles: iccprofiles/
- Patterns: patterns/
- out.php, subs_core.php, subs_win-1252.php – substitution tables/utilities.

Notes
-----
- Vendor assets; do not modify. Changes affect rendering consistency.
